run_train_alphastar_agent: run the alphastar training script with a config file to train an agent and save checkpoints
run_train_with_dummy_data: run training with a small batch size over 16 frames using DummyDataSource for debugging
run_train_with_warmstart: run training warmstarted from an existing checkpoint by setting init_checkpoint_path in the config
review_main_training_flow: review the main function that sets up architecture, loss, optimizer, data source, learner, and checkpointing runner
run_train_with_unique_checkpoints: run training with unique checkpoint directories by setting checkpoint_kwargs add_uid to True
